skill_name: Teach me how to bake a chocolate cake.
workflow: To bake a chocolate cake, preheat your oven to 350 degrees. Grease and flour a 9-inch round cake pan. In a medium bowl, mix together 1 ½ cups of all-purpose flour, 1 cup of sugar, ¾ cup of cocoa powder, 1 teaspoon of baking powder, 1 teaspoon of baking soda and ½ teaspoon of salt. In a separate bowl, whisk together 1 cup of buttermilk, 2 eggs, 3 tablespoons of melted butter and 1 tablespoon of vanilla extract.
